edge_threshold.method: Smallest claimed edge t (0-30% in 1% steps) such that past bets claiming t to t+5% returned more than 0 per unit staked at the 95% lower bound, and so did every higher band with at least 30 bets; ranges resample whole matches; found on development seasons, then checked on the latest season (bets at t and up must have returned more than 0).
edge_threshold.note: No minimum edge works. At every claimed edge from 0% to 30%, the 739 past player bets lost money or could plausibly have lost it, so no edge the model claims is large enough to trust. The best band was 13%-18%: 82 bets returned +25.9% a bet (range -61.9% to +145.4%).

lean.title: Blend Lean replayed on Pinnacle's early prices
lean.note: Blend Lean replayed on Pinnacle's early prices from football-data, not on DraftKings: each league's blend refitted every 28 days on earlier matches only, sigma from each fit's own matches, $1 a bet on the side at least 1 sigma above the early price's break-even, CLV against Pinnacle's margin-free close. Pinnacle is a sharper price than DraftKings, so this is a tougher test than the live one, and it isn't the live book: a blend fitted on Pinnacle and fed Pinnacle's own prices doesn't have the mismatch live Lean has (fitted on Pinnacle, fed DraftKings' price, with b above 1 sharpening it). The Champions League has no early prices: it is replayed at DraftKings' close and kept out of the pooled numbers.

rule.blend_fit: Pinnacle's margin-free close beside the model's walk-forward chance
rule.clv: entry odds x Pinnacle's margin-free (Shin) close - 1
rule.cup: Champions League at DraftKings' bought close (cup_backtest.py), CLV against Pinnacle's close at the same moment; kept out of `all`
rule.driver: market = still at least 1 sigma with the model's term taken out of the fitted blend (c = 0, a and b kept as fitted, no refit); model = only with it
rule.driver_note: Market-driven: the pick still clears 1 sigma when the model's term is taken out of the fitted blend (the blend's other weights are kept as fitted, not refitted). Model-driven: it clears 1 sigma only with the model's term in. The model's term compares the model's chances across home, draw and away, not against the price, so where the model's weight is positive it lifts the outcome the model rates highest relative to the others, even when the model rates that outcome below the market.

UCL.name: Champions League
UCL.note: Champions League, priced at the close, not early: the only cup prices we hold are the closes bought for 2024/25 and 2025/26 (Pinnacle and DraftKings, one snapshot a kickoff slot). Bets are taken at DraftKings' close on the cross-league model's walk-forward chances; CLV compares that price with Pinnacle's margin-free close at the same moment, so it shows how far DraftKings sits from Pinnacle, not price movement. Clubs the model doesn't cover and low-data matches are skipped, as in the live paper test. Blend Lean: the blend needs 300 earlier matches before its first fit (302 in all), so only 1 of the 295 candidate matches come after a fit, giving 0 bets: far too few to judge.

portfolios.name: Team corners
portfolios.note: Owner's live test (10 Oct): each team's corners, model (f) at a 12% edge against Pinnacle's team-corner prices in six leagues, $10 a trade; since 20 Oct the same rule also runs against DraftKings' prices as a second track. In development the model beat the league average in all six leagues, but its chances were well calibrated only in the Premier League, Serie A and Ligue 1; the locked February test decides it. There are no historical corner prices, so its backtest is the research record, not money.

backtest.title: Research record (no historical corner prices, so no priced backtest)
backtest.note: Football-data has no corner prices, so this strategy can't be replayed for money. These are the model tests behind it; the locked February test (2026/27 matches to 31 Jan 2027, opened no earlier than 3 Feb 2027) decides whether the model is right.
backtest.verdict: No edge shown. Each team's corners beat the league average, but the chances are too spread out; total corners do no better than the average.
